scope:
Pressure, expansion, radiation and isotope diagnostics from saved radial traces.

Run with the pinned NumPy/SciPy/pynucastro/Numba runtime used by the pulse model.
Default compares original64, optimized64, changed source64, and available128.
--manifest accepts [{label,family,result,trace?,reaction_flows?},...]. Paths can
be absolute or relative to docs/protium-fusion. New nuclear-rate variants should
set reaction_flows:false unless their exact rate arrays are supplied separately.
No hydro, archive edits, emissivity loss or new physics is introduced.
definitions: All pressure/density/radius extrema are over archived samples, not all solver steps.
Solver temperature peak is max over accepted solver states in the archived result, not a continuous-time supremum.
Pressure fields are thermodynamic EOS pressure; the separate artificial-viscosity fields describe the numerical shock stress/heating already present in the trajectory.
LTE radiation reservoir and pressure are already included in FastEOS internal energy/pressure.
Actual cumulative net escaped radiation is the model loss. No gross free-free emission is added as another loss.
The grey LTE model imposes equilibrium radiation; it does not resolve photon production, spectrum, absorption lines or non-LTE thermalization.
Reaction turnovers are sampled quadrature diagnostics; isotope inventories and integrated model energy are more accurate conserved ledgers.

reaction_flows.scope: Trapezoidal quadrature on saved samples; gross turnover clips tiny negative inventories, signed comparison retains solver polynomial. Reversible capture turnover is not net production. No cold-decay/recovery flow included.
reaction_flows.numerical_scope: Tiny flows below the inventory/step-error scale, especially neutron production and cancellation, are not resolved physical yield predictions. A positive-inventory quadrature can consume clipped numerical trace neutrons.
